tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gter srung zhing skyong chen po'i bskang ba phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300hūm̐/ ma lus bdud sder khros pa drag po'i sku /'jigs byed mi bzad zhing skyong seng gdong can// lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs kyi mkha' dbyings khyon// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis skong gyur cig /dgra bgegs dbang po'i me tog gsur chen spos// zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab klung*// sna tshogs sha sna'i zhal zas rnga chen sogs// snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra yis skong gyur cig /'chi med bdud rtsi dmar chen rak+ta'i mtsho// sha rus bza' bca'i gtor ma ri bor brtsigs// sna tshogs 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs// bzhed rgu'i char chen 'beb pas skong gyur cig /rlung ltar myur mgyogs rta nag sga srab can// 'brong g.yag spu zhol mche brjid rwa rnon ldan/ khyi nag gtum 'jigs mche sder rno ngar 'bar// lug nag rgyan ldan rnams kyis skong gyur cig /sku gzugs gleg bam dar nag ru mtshon dang*// dur khrod rgyan chas brjid pa'i ber nag gos// sra brtan go cha rno ngar ldan pa'i mtshon// rnam mang dam rdzas tshogs kyis skong gyur cig /dom nag tsit+tar srog 'khor sa bon bltems// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig mthun pa'i rdzas// ma tshang med kun ting 'dzin sngags rgya yis// bzhed pa ji bzhin spel bas skong gyur cig /mdor na so so'i thugs dang gang 'tsham pa'i// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// dam can zhing skyong yab yum las mkhan sogs// 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /dgyes par dgongs nas dam tshig rjes dgongs te// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi sogs// ji ltar bzhed pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa// thogs pa med par myur du 'grub par mdzod//
ces gter srung zhing skyong chen po'i bskang ba 'di yang sngags 'chang phrin las dbang drag bdud 'joms kyis bskul ngor 'gyur med rdo rjes smras pa'o/// /
